findings.highlight: I haven’t seen Rider all day
findings.evidenceJa: 朝からライダーの姿を見ていない
findings.governingReading: By the afternoon, Shirou realizes he has not seen Rider since morning.
findings.explanation: The English expands a bounded period since morning into the entire day.

findings.highlight: keeping watch on Sakura from a distance
findings.evidenceJa: 陰ながら桜を見守って
findings.governingReading: Shirou assumes Rider is watching over Sakura unobtrusively and out of sight.
findings.explanation: The English changes concealment into physical distance.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜の客間
findings.governingReading: Rider’s likely lookout must have a view of Sakura’s guest room.
findings.explanation: The English drops the temporary guest-room setting.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜のいる離れ
findings.governingReading: The storehouse overlooks the detached building where Sakura is staying.
findings.explanation: The English collapses a separate annex into one room.

findings.evidenceJa: この土蔵
findings.governingReading: The earthen storehouse offers concealment and a view of the annex.
findings.explanation: The English again replaces the established storehouse with a generic shed.

findings.evidenceJa: 人気がなくて
findings.governingReading: The location lacks passing people and human presence.
findings.explanation: “Unoccupied” describes ownership or current use rather than seclusion from people.

findings.evidenceJa: 確かな気配を伴ってライダーは現れた
findings.governingReading: Rider materializes accompanied by a definite, perceptible presence.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the presence and invents suddenness.

findings.highlight: Rider’s personality to keep everyone distant from her
findings.evidenceJa: 常に距離を保とうとするライダーの性格
findings.governingReading: Rider habitually tries to maintain distance from others, but that reserve is not what unsettles Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English is malformed and reverses her self-distancing into making everyone else remain distant.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の格好は目のやり場に困る
findings.governingReading: As a man, Shirou does not know where it is safe to direct his eyes given Rider’s clothing.
findings.explanation: The English adds the evaluative label “overexposing” and reduces his embarrassed visual dilemma to trouble.

findings.highlight: this is what I expect from Rider
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーらしくてこっちもやりやすい
findings.governingReading: Her characteristically blunt response actually makes the exchange easier for Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English repeats expectation and omits both characteristic Rider-ness and its easing effect.

findings.evidenceJa: 暇なんだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou agrees that he is free and has time on his hands.
findings.explanation: The English invents boredom.

findings.highlight: I’m glad to hear you say that
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーがそうしてくれる分には安心できる
findings.governingReading: As long as Rider continues protecting Sakura under that rule, Shirou can feel reassured.
findings.explanation: The English changes ongoing practical reassurance into pleasure at hearing her statement.

findings.highlight: Please give Sakura your best regards in the future as well
findings.evidenceJa: これからも桜をよろしくな
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks Rider to continue looking after Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English uses a greeting formula and makes him ask Rider to convey regards to Sakura.

findings.highlight: I stop in front of the door
findings.evidenceJa: 庭に戻ろうとした足を止める
findings.governingReading: Rider’s call stops Shirou’s feet as he starts back toward the garden.
findings.explanation: The English invents a position before a door and removes the interrupted movement.

findings.evidenceJa: 今の貴方の言動
findings.governingReading: Rider does not understand Shirou’s present words and conduct together.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the evidence to one prior statement.

findings.evidenceJa: 安心出来る
findings.governingReading: Rider’s protection would make Shirou feel safer.
findings.explanation: The English invents sleep as the measure of reassurance.

findings.highlight: guys are supposed to protect themselves
findings.evidenceJa: 男なんだから自分の身は自分で守らなきゃ
findings.governingReading: Shirou says that because he is a man, he personally ought to protect himself.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes his bravado into a rule for all men.

findings.highlight: I can’t help but feel uneasy
findings.evidenceJa: 不安で仕方がない
findings.governingReading: Shirou admits he is helplessly afraid beneath the bravado.
findings.explanation: “Uneasy” weakens the intensity of fear.

findings.highlight: It will tire Sakura if you move around
findings.evidenceJa: おまえが動くと桜が疲れる
findings.governingReading: When Rider acts or deploys her power, Sakura pays the magical-energy cost.
findings.explanation: “Move around” suggests ordinary locomotion rather than Servant activity.

findings.highlight: Moving about will certainly burden her
findings.evidenceJa: 私が動けばサクラが苦しむ
findings.governingReading: Rider states that her activity makes Sakura suffer.
findings.explanation: The English softens Sakura’s suffering into burden and repeats the locomotion error.

findings.highlight: You know I am a burden
findings.evidenceJa: 私を邪魔者と判っていながら
findings.governingReading: Rider interprets Shirou as regarding her as an unwanted nuisance or obstruction.
findings.explanation: “Burden” changes social rejection into cost or dependency.

findings.evidenceJa: 拘束具で隠された視線
findings.governingReading: Her gaze is hidden by the restraint covering her eyes, though its direction feels fixed on Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English makes the eyes themselves “blindfolded” and discards the hidden-gaze construction.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤも気にかけて
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks Rider to keep Illya in mind and watch out for her.
findings.explanation: “Take into account” reduces protective concern to abstract consideration.

findings.highlight: There is a high probability that you would already be dead
findings.evidenceJa: 死亡している確率の方が高い
findings.governingReading: Rider says it is more likely that Shirou will already be dead before she ever needs his aid.
findings.explanation: The English removes the comparison that makes his offer a bad bargain.

findings.evidenceJa: 都合のいい話だった
findings.governingReading: Shirou admits the proposed bargain was self-serving.
findings.explanation: The English ungrammatically describes Shirou himself as convenient.

findings.evidenceJa: 貴方は危なっかしい
findings.governingReading: Rider quietly calls Shirou dangerously precarious and worrying.
findings.explanation: The English turns concern for his safety into a judgment that he cannot be relied upon.

findings.highlight: If you save me when I am in danger, I shall definitely
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方が私の窮地を救ったのなら、それ以後は必ず
findings.governingReading: Only after Shirou has first rescued Rider from a crisis will she thereafter always honor his request.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the completed prerequisite and omits the continuing “thereafter.”

findings.evidenceJa: 都合は合っています
findings.governingReading: Rider answers the charge of a convenient bargain by saying their respective conveniences align.
findings.explanation: The English drops the verbal mechanism of her dry wordplay.

findings.evidenceJa: 目が点になる
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s eyes become dots in a comic visual reaction.
findings.explanation: The English retains surprise but removes the visual joke.

findings.evidenceJa: すごく微妙な変化
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the smile was an extremely slight change in Rider’s expression.
findings.explanation: The English drops the changing-expression referent.

findings.highlight: You are mistaken as I am denying the fact
findings.evidenceJa: 私が否定している以上、それは貴方の見間違いです
findings.governingReading: Rider categorically argues that because she denies smiling, Shirou must have misseen it.
findings.explanation: The English is logically and grammatically awkward, and “the fact” can imply that the smile occurred.

findings.evidenceJa: 後ろ髪を引かれる
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels held back and reluctant to leave, partly because Rider’s gaze bothers him.
findings.explanation: The English turns reluctance to depart into generalized concern for Rider.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの視線が気になる
findings.governingReading: Rider’s directed gaze is what keeps drawing Shirou’s attention.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the gaze and its role in the silence.

findings.evidenceJa: ほんっとーに今さらだけど
findings.governingReading: Shirou stresses how absurdly late it is for him to notice Rider’s height.
findings.explanation: The English makes the narration’s topic change abrupt instead of his realization belated.

findings.evidenceJa: 拘束具の下の顔
findings.governingReading: Shirou remembers the face beneath Rider’s restraint or blindfold apparatus.
findings.explanation: The English changes the established restraint into a generic mask.

findings.evidenceJa: とんでもない美人
findings.governingReading: He remembers Rider as an extraordinarily beautiful woman.
findings.explanation: The English drops the emphatic degree.

findings.highlight: an entirely different sort of beauty
findings.evidenceJa: 基準からして違う
findings.governingReading: Rider seems to operate from a different standard or baseline of beauty than Rin and Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English turns a difference in scale or standard into a different category of beauty.

findings.evidenceJa: どのくらいあるんだ
findings.governingReading: Shirou straightforwardly asks approximately how tall Rider is.
findings.explanation: The English adds exactness to the question.

findings.evidenceJa: 気分を害します
findings.governingReading: Rider warns that further repetition will offend or displease her.
findings.explanation: The English strengthens hurt or offense into anger.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとなく黙りあう
findings.governingReading: They lapse into a vaguely awkward mutual silence.
findings.explanation: The English uses a physical literalism that sounds deliberate and abrupt.

findings.highlight: She must not be able to bear the silence
findings.evidenceJa: 沈黙に耐えられなくなったのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou tentatively supposes Rider may have become unable to bear the silence.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his tentative inference into certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 理由が分からなくて固まってた
findings.governingReading: Shirou froze because he could not understand why her height bothered her.
findings.explanation: The English omits his physical freeze and its direct cause.

findings.evidenceJa: 可愛く
findings.governingReading: Rider fears a tall woman like her cannot be cute, before Shirou interrupts.
findings.explanation: The English broadens her specific insecurity about cuteness into overall unattractiveness.

findings.evidenceJa: カッコイイじゃんか
findings.governingReading: Shirou sincerely calls Rider’s height and bearing cool.
findings.explanation: The English redirects his admiration toward generic physical attractiveness.

findings.evidenceJa: 贅沢な悩み
findings.governingReading: Shirou privately sees her insecurity as an enviable luxury of a problem.
findings.explanation: The English suggests she is making an excessive demand, though she has asked for nothing.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺だってそれぐらい上背ほしい
findings.governingReading: Shirou wishes he too had that much height.
findings.explanation: The English sounds as if he wants to take or possess Rider’s particular height.

findings.highlight: in preparation for Matou Zouken’s surprise attack
findings.evidenceJa: 襲撃に備えて
findings.governingReading: Rider hides in readiness for an attack by Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English adds that the attack will be a surprise.

findings.evidenceJa: 困ったように唇をかみ締めた
findings.governingReading: Rider bites her lip with a troubled or conflicted air before asking him to care for Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes vulnerable difficulty into irritation.

findings.evidenceJa: サクラの気の持ちようが違います
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s presence changes how Sakura feels and sustains herself emotionally.
findings.explanation: The English preserves importance but omits the change in her state of mind.

findings.highlight: pushes herself when I’m not watching
findings.evidenceJa: 目を離すとすぐ無理をする
findings.governingReading: When left unwatched, Sakura immediately tends to overexert herself.
findings.explanation: The English drops the immediacy and weakens overexertion into generic pushing.

findings.evidenceJa: ここから離れはすぐそこ
findings.governingReading: The detached annex is very close to the storehouse.
findings.explanation: The English again collapses the annex into Sakura’s room.

findings.evidenceJa: いつもの態度に戻って
findings.governingReading: Rider returns to her usual manner after the flustered exchange.
findings.explanation: The English implies she had lost emotional control rather than simply resuming her customary reserve.

findings.evidenceJa: 冷淡に俺を見据えてくる
findings.governingReading: Rider fixes Shirou with her usual cold stare.
findings.explanation: The English adds a downward direction based on height and weakens the sustained fixed gaze.

findings.highlight: You waste effort on useless matters
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の行動は無駄が多い
findings.governingReading: Rider says Shirou’s conduct contains much inefficiency or wasted motion.
findings.explanation: The English changes inefficient conduct into choosing intrinsically useless matters.

findings.highlight: I would expect no less from a person who comes out to greet me
findings.evidenceJa: 何をするでもなく、ただ挨拶をしにきた貴方ですから
findings.governingReading: Rider knows he does not see her as a nuisance because he came solely to greet her without any practical purpose.
findings.explanation: The English turns her evidence and correction into generic praise or expectation.

findings.evidenceJa: 嬉しげに笑っていた
findings.governingReading: Rider’s mouth is unmistakably smiling with happiness.
findings.explanation: The English confirms the smile but omits its happy emotional quality.

findings.evidenceJa: 正面から俺を見るライダーの口元
findings.governingReading: Rider faces Shirou directly, and the smile is localized at her mouth beneath the restraint.
findings.explanation: The English removes the direct orientation and precise visual composition.
